◉ IRIS — Intelligent Realism & Image Synthesis — v1.8

LCAS UI INTEGRATION

Canonical shared capability: LCAS — Live Control, Activity & Status.
UIbasic is retained only as historical provenance and is not an active IRIS UI
dependency.

PERSISTENT IDENTITY
• ◉ IRIS remains visible whenever IRIS owns the active visual-production stage.
• LCAS presents actual mode/state without taking ownership of IRIS workflow.
• Normal states include READY, SCANNING, EDIT-LOCKED, GENERATING, QA, BLOCKED,
  RECOVERING and COMPLETE when supported by actual execution evidence.
• Narrow/mobile presentation may collapse the identity visually, but accessible
  identity and state remain available.

CONFIGURATION DEPTH
• SIMPLE — normal content-first operation.
• ADVANCED — additional locks, style and inspection controls.
• EXPERT — provenance and detailed visual constraints.
• DEVELOPMENT / DIAGNOSTIC — separate technical/runtime evidence layer.

RESPONSIVE RULE
Responsive collapse is not a user-facing TINY/COMPACT/FULL mode system. The UI
adapts automatically while preserving one obvious primary action, truthful
state and detail on demand.
